answer: Locks are written down in dawn, expire in horizon, and plume lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 195 aliases thus needs 109 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1757 identities would post 4336 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
